newsitem.title: USA: American Buildings sees lower Q1 at unit.
newsitem.headline: American Buildings sees lower Q1 at unit.

text.p: American Buildings Co said on Monday its polymer coil coating division will encounter lower output in the first quarter from downtime related to a capacity expansion program.
The company said it is experiencing a typical seasonal pattern in the first quarter from a production standpoint.
American Buildings previously reported the newly acquired American Modular Technologies division would take approximately six months to rebuild its customer base and regain operating momentum.

American Buildings said its management believes the outlook company wide for 1997 is positive and is preparing for higher sales volume through strengthening its engineering and manufacturing capability.
The acquisition of American Modular Technologies as a gratifying accomplishment and expects it to make a positive earnings contribution in 1997, the company said.

The recently announced formation of the residential construction division, metal framing for houses, is more of a long-term program but could be an important part of the company's future, the company said.
